target_customer: Teams building cloud coding agents and mobile app tools, such as app builders and testing startups
problem: Coding agents run in Linux sandboxes and cannot build or test iOS apps, which need Xcode and the iOS Simulator. Limrun provides remote Xcode, iOS Simulator and Android Emulator.
business_model: Usage based pricing split between idle time and build time
product_category: Developer infrastructure, cloud mobile simulators for AI agents

founders.name: Muvaffak Onus
founders.background_notes: Maintainer of Crossplane and tech lead for its providers at Upbound; led the team building web and mobile testing sandboxes at QA Wolf.

competitors.name: BrowserStack
competitors.what: Real device and simulator cloud for mobile testing

competitors.name: Appetize
competitors.what: Cloud streamed iOS and Android simulators for testing and demos

competitors.name: Corellium
competitors.what: ARM virtualization for iOS, security focused

technical_complexity.rationale: Streaming simulators at 60 fps with remote Xcode builds and caching requires Apple hardware orchestration, which is hard for a one person team.

defensibility.rationale: Several agent focused competitors appeared in 2026 and Expo launched its own cloud simulators, so differentiation rests on integration with agent platforms.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Expo EAS Simulator and other agent focused cloud simulators launched during 2026, per search coverage, so the wedge was being contested.

market_need_then: Cloud coding agents cannot run local simulators, a limitation noted in Expo's docs. Customers named by Limrun include Replit and Rork, a company claim.

branding.domain_note: Started on lim.run and redirects to limrun.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Developer focused: Unlock cloud agents for mobile dev teams

branding.brand_signature: Mission to cloudify every local development utility

rebrands.why: Domain moved to the .com; reason not sourced

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive short name and a clear tagline, but no press, community or merch coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Limrun is a Spring 2026 company led by a solo founder with strong infrastructure credentials and named customers among agent builders. Funding is unverified and the category drew several rivals within months, including Expo, so the outcome depends on staying the default simulator layer for agent platforms.
notes: Unverified funding: FundedIQ lists 500K pre seed in June 2026, PitchBook 150K, Preqin an undisclosed seed from Pioneer Fund and Y Combinator. None confirmed so no round is recorded. Competitor sources are 2026 guides, not dated launch coverage near founding in 2025. Preqin describes the company incorrectly as a logistics business. Completeness pass: Round rests on a single database (FundedIQ); PitchBook lists 150K and Preqin an undisclosed seed from Pioneer Fund and Y Combinator, so amount and stage are uncertain.
